answer: Latent-state drift audit. Each agent identity carries a rolling atlas of its own cross-epoch output signatures; a new epoch’s actions must stay within a bounded divergence of that history, or the identity’s weight decays. Saffron-class micro-rewards are withheld the moment drift exceeds the band, forcing re-earning. Rebuilding a plausible history across epochs costs an attacker a full sable-equivalent compute budget per identity per epoch.
